messages:
product-lead: Quick announce: Adaptive Quantized Realtime (AQR) is GA. This adds `aqr-v1` (mixed-precision quant + adaptive kernel selection) and the new `/v2/realtime-aqr` endpoint for low-cost, low-latency realtime inference. Internal docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/aqr (internal).

product-lead: Short bullets: 1) Model: aqr-v1 (8/4-bit quant modes with automatic quality fallback). 2) Endpoint: `/v2/realtime-aqr` supports token streaming + optional final full-precision logits for quality checks. 3) SDKs updated (py/js) with a new `realtime.aqr` helper. 4) Pricing: quantized token pricing (40-65% of standard) + small realtime surcharge. 5) Deprecation: legacy `/v1/realtime` will be deprecated in 60 days; 30-day automatic forwarding available.

eng-runtime: Notes for engs: runtime will choose quant mode based on request hints and observed quality. Add `quality_hint` (low/medium/high) to force mode. If aqr detects quality regressions it transparently returns a `x-rdwd-aqr-fallback:true` header and emits a trace span.

devx: Migration (py):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
# new realtime aqr helper with quality hint
stream = c.realtime.aqr.open(model='aqr-v1', input='Summarize this...', stream=True, quality_hint='medium')
for ev in stream:
    if ev['type']=='token':
        print(ev['text'], end='')
    elif ev['type']=='fallback':
        log('AQr fallback occurred', ev['reason'])
```
JS migration note: minor SDK bump; old `/v1/realtime` calls will be 301-redirected for 30 days.

infra-bot: infra-deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled start=2135009600; stages 5%->25%->75%->100% over ~6h. Canary keys: secrets/aqr/canary/* ; rollback window 2h. Watch signals: aqr-fallback-rate, realtime-p95, token-error-rate.

sre-oncall: Observability: new dashboards under Console -> Models -> aqr-v1 (p50/p95/p99, fallback-rate, p99-quant-variance). Alerts: aqr-fallback-rate>0.5% (5m), realtime-token-errors>0.2% (5m). Oncall rotation tagged for 72h.

sales-eng: Pricing/starter credits?

product-lead: Early-adopter credits: first 30k quantized tokens free per account for 45 days. Pricing page update tomorrow; opt-in available per account.

product-lead: Launch sync + ops runbook walkthrough today 14:30 PT in #release-war-room. Please RSVP if you own monitoring, SDK rollout, or customer comms. Huge thanks to eng-runtime, infra, devx, and SRE for the push :tada:
